name: SATENA
body: HSTS marked for preload, nosniff, framing limited to its origin, and a strict Referrer-Policy. But none of the 20 pages read declares a canonical URL, so search engines guess which version to index.
lesson: Add a self-referencing canonical to every page, plus hreflang links between the language versions.
summary: www.satena.com scores 78 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 21 are at risk, and 19 pass. Fix first: analytics may count some visits twice.

fix.title: Analytics may count some visits twice
fix.evidence: 20 pages load gtag.js more than once.
fix.fix: Keep one GA4 property per site and load gtag.js once, or manage it only inside Tag Manager.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 20 pages have no canonical link
fix.evidence: /en, /en/servicios, /en/web-check-in, /en/vuelos-nacionales and 16 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking signals.
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages read.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager appear in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: 1 title is shared by more than one page
fix.evidence: "Fly More with These Offers | SATENA Airline" on /en/ofertas?c%C3%B3digo=TBD-PPN, /en/ofertas?desde=Barranquilla, /en/ofertas?desde=Pizarro and 1 more.
fix.fix: Write a title that names what is different about each page.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 680 ms
Every page has a meta description
